title: Ella Fitzgerald and Peg Leg Bates with Andy Kirk
summary: With Andy Kirk, Gabriel travelled with Ella Fitzgerald and one-legged tap dancer Pegleg Bates.

bands.name: Andy Kirk and His Clouds of Joy

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Oh yes, well like that most of the fellas were doing for quite a while. Well, a lot of the arrangements from Offer Records, different bands were making because Ella Fitzgerald was out to see. She was in the band, her and Hot Lips and Pig Lake Bates was in the band when I played with Andy Kirk. Really? Yeah, Ella Fitzgerald and Pig Lake Bates. They were with Kirk? They were traveling with Kirk? That's right, yeah, they was traveling with Kirk.
That's how I got to work with them.
I never saw Bates. What did he do actually?
He was a tap dancer with a leg and a peg. They call it peg leg peat. One legged.
But he could actually tap dance.
He could actually tap dance. Yeah. That's him. He was good.
